items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What's that trumpet player now, Mr. Leroy, a meter on between Santa and Albany, Bill Slater?

ctx.x: Yes indeed, Sydney Vane, that's right. You had some good times, right? I could barely call that whole Golden Leaf band, I mean, yeah. Jesse was playing banjo with them. Well at that time my cousin was the manager of the band, George Davis, they used to call Dugia for a nickname. He died with a heart attack on a truck, I mean, the living girl should die with a heart attack on a truck.
What's that trumpet player now, Mr. Leroy, a meter on between Santa and Albany, Bill Slater? Oh, okay. Willie Webber. He used to play Trevor. I thought you meant to have him.
Maybe Bruce was telling us about him.
